headline: Spain raises fuel discount to 20 cents per litre and extends support until December
summary: Spain's new anti-crisis decree, due for Council of Ministers approval on Tuesday, raises the fuel discount to 20 cents per litre. The support then falls to 13 cents in November and six cents in December.
why: Fuel taxes and discounts directly shape retail pump prices and household inflation, which feed into Spanish consumer spending and government budget decisions.
